# Table of contents {.unnumbered .inn-front-lists}

<!--
A file whose heading carries the `.inn-front-lists` class stands for the table
of contents: the heading text becomes the title of the contents, and the list
of figures, the list of tables and the list of papers (whichever of them are
switched on in _quarto.yml) follow it. The university's PhD template puts them
straight after the preface, before any list of abbreviations. Delete this file
to have them inserted automatically at the end of the front matter instead.
-->
